description: Classify a currency's macro regime using policy rate, inflation, GDP, and unemployment context, with explicit assumptions and confidence notes. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (case-insensitive). Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.
